$comment: DRAFT NICE Plus work role. Not a NIST product. Core/additional flags and added statements are nice-plus judgments, not NIST's. Statements were chosen by relevance to the role, not from coverage tags.
title: Controls / Automation Engineer (Security Duties)
description: DRAFT. Designs, programs, commissions and maintains control systems (PLCs, HMIs, drives, and the networks that connect them) and is responsible for the security of the logic and configurations they own. NICE has no role for the engineers who write and change controller programs; NICE work role DD-WRL-009 covers OT security engineering but not control system programming.

citations.locator: §3.3.2 Build and Train a Cross-Functional Team (PDF p. 55)
citations.note: Names control engineers as members of the OT cybersecurity team.
Secure coding practices aimed at the engineers who program PLCs.

open_questions: Is one role right for both design-side controls engineers and plant-floor automation technicians, or should they be split?
Should this role inherit any of DD-WRL-009, or stay standalone with selected statements as now?
